provenance.source: Practice owner pricing and starting-care baseline supplied for the authorized website UX clarification
provenance.baseline: Complimentary 10-minute phone or virtual consultation; 26-minute consultation scheduled in a 30-minute block for $75; a separate one-hour couples consultation for $150; an initial individual evaluation for $150 private pay or applicable insurance; a separate $150 reduced-cost couples/family program, not a general fee for all ongoing sessions.
provenance.verificationLimit: The repository previously supplied scheduling guidance and practice/clinician destinations, but no priced service catalog or service IDs for these amounts. This record preserves owner-supplied public information; it does not claim a fresh SimplePractice appointment-menu, payer-participation, availability, or clinical review.
provenance.scope: Clarify starting costs and distinguish services. Preserve the short couples consultation, separate partner evaluations, and then joint-session sequence. Do not infer that the separate one-hour consultation replaces required preparation or that the reduced-cost program is the rate for every ongoing session.
